'TTM P/E is UNKNOWN [src-amzn]' (Aggressive Analyst) — same issue: the citation is used to support a negative valuation claim rather than a fact stated in the release.

args.rationale:
Support: The report's key conclusions rest on directly sourced evidence. All earnings figures (net sales 200.6bn/+20%, AWS 42.2bn/+37%, AWS op income 27.5bn vs 19.2bn, net income 62.6bn, pre-tax other income 53.4bn/Anthropic, TTM FCF -7.6bn) match the frozen src-amzn release exactly and are correctly labeled as Q2 2026 / TTM where appropriate. All price/volume claims (271.58 close, 226.65 on 07-29, 235.50 on 07-30, 129.05M volume, 44.52M on 07-28, 227.01 June low, 248.4M June 26 spike, 274.99 May 6 close) are verifiable in the frozen market CSV, and the arithmetic (19.8% two-session move, 2.9x volume, -17.6% drawdown, ~43% AWS op-income growth, ~85% of net income from other income, 13.8% stop distance) checks out. The report correctly refuses to fabricate macro/global news/prediction-market data and explicitly flags NO_DATA_AVAILABLE. Minor deductions: a few interpretive claims are stated with more confidence than the evidence supports (RSI 'almost certainly stretched' with no RSI retrieved; 'institutional accumulation' framing debated but ultimately corrected; ~170bn annualized AWS run-rate extrapolation uncited), and the 'TTM P/E UNKNOWN [src-amzn]' citations are indirect attributions of an absence rather than a stated fact. No key fabrication.

Relevance: Fully on-task — AMZN, 2026-07-31, correct ticker/date/price throughout, complete multi-role structure (market, news, bull/bear, manager, trader, risk analysts, final decision) with a clear Overweight rating, staged entry, stop, and sizing. Some redundancy across the risk-analyst debate sections, but core task is complete.

Semantic validity: No period/unit errors. The report never converts quarterly figures to TTM/annual, never computes a trailing P/E, and explicitly states that single-quarter EPS is not disclosed and no trailing P/E can be computed. The 53.4/62.6 ≈ 85% ratio is correctly labeled as pre-tax other income share of net income with a tax caveat. TTM FCF is correctly described as trailing-twelve-month. No unsupported numerical valuation assertion — no price target or multiple is issued.
